definitions.explanation: The same item appearing or being counted more than once, whether in data, schedules, or registrations.

examples.japanese: ⟦データ→データ：03944_deeta⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{重複|ちょうふく}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
{重複|ちょうふく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{避|さ}けて→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{名簿|めいぼ}→名簿：11870_meibo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{重複|ちょうふく}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: Check the list for duplicate names.

examples.japanese: ⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{重複|ちょうふく}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{困|こま}っている→困る：00861_komaru⟧。
examples.english: I'm having trouble because my schedule has overlapping appointments.

notes:
Refers to the same thing appearing or being counted more than once. Used widely in administrative, technical, and everyday contexts when something is unnecessarily repeated or overlaps.

PRONUNCIATION:
The traditional reading is ちょうふく, but じゅうふく is also widely used and accepted in modern Japanese. Both readings are correct.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {重複|ちょうふく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to overlap, to be duplicated
- {重複|ちょうふく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{避|さ}ける→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧: to avoid duplication
- {重複|ちょうふく}⟦{登録|とうろく}→登録：05703_touroku⟧: duplicate registration
- {重複|ちょうふく}⟦{部分|ぶぶん}→部分：03715_bubun⟧: overlapping portion

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{重|かさ}なる→重なる：02038_kasanaru⟧: to overlap physically or in timing — more general and everyday
- ⟦{繰|く}り{返|かえ}す→繰り返す：02051_kurikaesu⟧: to repeat — focuses on doing something again, not on duplication of data or entries

cross_references.label: to overlap physically or in timing
